entities.summary: Catherine Amanda Fülöp García is a Venezuelan and Argentine actress, model, beauty pageant contestant, television presenter and radio host. She participated in the Miss Venezuela 1986, finishing as the fourth runner–up and in Miss Latin America, finishing as the third runner–up. Fülöp has since launched a successful acting career throughout Latin America, most notably on television.
